human_actions_pending.context: npm run install:local finished this session and copied the release build to %LOCALAPPDATA%\Programs\Bucket\Zenith.exe. A browser tab at localhost:5173 cannot call Tauri invoke, so the live scroll and drag were not exercised there.

decisions.decision: Cover search uses Openverse, 20 results per page, and appends the next page when the grid sentinel scrolls into view.
decisions.rationale: Unsplash needs a client id this app cannot embed. The first request used to stop at 12 with no next page. Page 1 clears library/cover-search; later pages append. A process lock stops a new search from wiping thumbs a previous page is still writing.

decisions.decision: cover_x and cover_y (0-100, default 50) are the image point that should sit in the middle of whatever frame shows the cover.
decisions.rationale: object-position percentages do not mean the same crop on a 2:1 band and a square tile. Storing the image point keeps that point centered in both. Existing covers stay center-cropped.

decisions.decision: Goals frame a wide cover. Countries and places frame a square. Move writes focus only; it does not download the photo again.
decisions.rationale: The goal page has a 2:1 band. Country and place covers are the square tiles. A country tile can show a place photo when the country has no cover of its own; own_cover stops Move from saving a focus the tile will ignore.

decisions.decision: Goals are their own table, not a kind of country. The library folder stays Documents\Bucket. The header is the word Zenith. The icon is the existing white-ink mountain.
decisions.rationale: The user asked for an all-purpose bucket list without losing destinations or the photos already on disk, and rejected logo restyles.
